invariant: Every dataset/model outcome is logged; infeasible rows have no metric

randomforest.missing_values: No wrapper-level prohibition; categorical values use OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'). Numeric missing-value artifact behavior is not separately certified.
randomforest.artifact_requirements: The supplied unit_price regression artifact requires its persisted 11-column pizza schema.
randomforest.environment_restrictions: Supplied artifact verified with scikit-learn 1.9.0 and joblib 1.6.0.

lightgbm.missing_values: Fitted medians handle numeric nulls; categorical nulls become 'Unknown'.
lightgbm.categorical_features: Label-encoded; unseen inference labels are rejected by the fitted encoder.
lightgbm.artifact_requirements: Supplied artifact requires the four persisted blood-donation feature names.
lightgbm.environment_restrictions: Verified in the pinned Pipeline 2 model environment.
lightgbm.source: lightgbm_config.py binary objective, model validation, and fitted preprocessor

xgboost.missing_values: Training preprocessing fills nulls; inference-time fill state is not persisted by the current preprocessor.
xgboost.categorical_features: Label-encoded; unseen inference labels are rejected.
xgboost.artifact_requirements: Model and matching fitted preprocessor must be loaded together.
xgboost.environment_restrictions: Pinned XGBoost 3.3.0 / scikit-learn 1.6.1 environment required for verified reuse.
xgboost.source: xgboost_config.py binary:logistic objective, model validation, and preprocessor

catboost.missing_values: Fitted medians handle numeric nulls; categorical nulls become 'Unknown'.
catboost.categorical_features: Supported as object/string columns by the fitted preprocessor and CatBoost.
catboost.artifact_requirements: Supplied artifact requires the four persisted blood-donation feature names.
catboost.environment_restrictions: Verified in the pinned Pipeline 2 model environment.
catboost.source: catboost_config.py Logloss objective, model validation, and fitted preprocessor

tabpfn.missing_values: No repository preprocessing; values are passed unchanged to TabPFNClassifier.
tabpfn.categorical_features: No repository encoding or categorical-feature indices are supplied; compatibility is delegated to TabPFN.
tabpfn.artifact_requirements: Pretrained classifier artifact and at least two target classes are required.
tabpfn.environment_restrictions: Verified with tabpfn 8.5.0, torch 2.11.0+cu128, and scikit-learn 1.6.1.
tabpfn.source: tabpfn_model.py plus TabPFN 8.5 inference_config pretraining limits

xtab.missing_values: Numeric nulls use fitted means at inference; categorical nulls use a learned missing token. Regression targets cannot be missing/non-numeric.
xtab.categorical_features: Supported with learned mappings and an unknown-category index.
xtab.artifact_requirements: Checkpoint must contain model_state_dict, model_config, and a fitted preprocessor with the training schema.
xtab.environment_restrictions: Training runtime remains unresolved; load/predict verified with torch 2.8.0+cpu and 2.11.0+cu128.
xtab.source: xtab_trainer.py, xtab_preprocessor.py, xtab_model.py, and checkpoint inspection

realmlp.missing_values: LYNX fits numeric medians on train only; pytabkit handles categorical missing/unknown values through its fitted converter.
realmlp.categorical_features: pytabkit RealMLP-TD internally one-hot encodes cardinality <=8 (threshold 9 includes unknown) and embeds larger cardinalities.
realmlp.numeric_features: pytabkit internally applies median centering, robust scaling, smooth clipping, and numerical embeddings.
realmlp.artifact_requirements: Fresh fitted PytabkitCandidate containing its train-fitted LYNX preprocessor and pytabkit estimator.
realmlp.source: pytabkit RealMLP_TD_Classifier/Regressor interfaces and installed source defaults

tabm.missing_values: LYNX fits numeric medians on train only; pytabkit's fitted converter handles categorical missing/unknown values.
tabm.categorical_features: pytabkit TabM-D internally one-hot encodes categorical values.
tabm.numeric_features: pytabkit internally applies its configured quantile-style transformation.
tabm.artifact_requirements: Fresh fitted PytabkitCandidate containing its train-fitted LYNX preprocessor and pytabkit estimator.
tabm.environment_restrictions: pytabkit 1.7.3; GPU optional, CPU and MPS supported.
tabm.source: pytabkit TabM_D_Classifier/Regressor interfaces and installed source defaults
